units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 14:1">Yeb. XIV, 1</cite> <he>כשם שהוא כונס בר׳ וכ׳</he> as well as he (a deaf mute) may marry by gestures, he may divorce by gesture; <cite ref="Gittin 71a:11">Gitt. 71ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 59a:11">Ib. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>בגיטין דברי הכל בר׳</he> as to letters of divorce, all agree that a deaf mute may divorce by gesture.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:1">Gen. R. s. 5</cite>, beg. <he>שואלים … בר׳ וכ׳</he> they greeted the king with gestures, with fingering and with flags; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:1">ib.</cite> s. 28; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 7">Yalk. ib. 7</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 848:1">Yalk. Ps. 848</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>רְמִיזוֹת</he>.
Yeb. 108ᵇ, v. קְרִיצָה.—[Lam. R. to I, 13 כמה ר׳ עשיתי, perh. to be read: רְמִיּוֹת tricks.]
